description.narrative: The project is implemented in Zimbabwe. The main outcome areas it contributes to are advancing equality and workers rights building new alliances and pushing progressive politics. The main right holders are workers. Through research and analysis, education, training and sensitization, and advocacy and engagement, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between LEDRIZ and the Palme Center. LEDRIZ is an initiative of the Zimbabwe Congress of Trade Unions (ZCTU) and it is established as a Trust. It was established in September 2003. LEDRIZ was established to develop, through research, well-grounded pro-working people policy positions designed to influence development processes and outcomes at national, regional and international levels.Other Donors to the OrganisationFOS Belgium Solidarity Centre Rosa Luxemburg Foundation International Labour Organisation (ILO) Friedrich Ebert Stiftung (FES) PACT-ZIM Open Society in Southern Africa (OSISAProject ObjectiveThe aims and objectives of the cooperation are to ensure that the recommendations of the Commission of Inquiry are fully implemented, and that the ZCTU is fully capacitated to play its role in the proposed compensation framework and process, that the laws are strengthened and modernized and that workers and unions are educated on insurance and pensions and are adequately capacitated to protect their members against prejudice and loss of value and realize their benefit expectations.
